vehicleTypes.label: Van or 4x4 with a car transporter trailer

documents.label: Profile photo
documents.hint: A clear, recent photo of your face, like a passport photo. Customers see it on their tracking page so they know who is coming.

documents.label: Right to work in the UK
documents.hint: Your UK or Irish passport, or the result page from gov.uk/prove-right-to-work. If your permission to work ends on a date, add it.
documents.referenceLabel: Share code, if you used one

documents.label: Proof of address
documents.hint: A utility bill, council tax bill or bank statement from the last three months, showing your name and address.

documents.label: Basic DBS certificate
documents.hint: Issued in the last 12 months. Customers are often alone with the driver, so this is checked for everyone. Apply at gov.uk/request-copy-criminal-record.

documents.label: Driving licence (front)
documents.hint: A photo of the front of your photocard licence. The expiry date is printed in section 4b.

documents.label: Driving licence (back)
documents.hint: A photo of the back, showing the categories you can drive.

documents.label: Driver CPC card
documents.hint: Your Driver Qualification Card. Needed to drive a vehicle over 3.5 tonnes for work.

documents.label: Digital tachograph card
documents.hint: Your driver card for vehicles over 3.5 tonnes.

documents.label: Recovery vehicle insurance
documents.hint: A motor trade or commercial vehicle policy that covers recovery and towing work, with you named as a driver.

documents.label: Goods in transit insurance
documents.hint: Covers customers' vehicles while they are on your truck. At least £50,000 is recommended.

documents.label: Public liability insurance
documents.hint: At least £1 million of cover. £5 million is expected for motorway work.

documents.label: Vehicle logbook (V5C)
documents.hint: The logbook for the vehicle you will recover with.

documents.label: MOT or annual test certificate
documents.hint: The current MOT, or the annual test for a vehicle over 3.5 tonnes. You can check it at gov.uk/check-mot-history.

documents.label: Operator's licence (O-licence)
documents.hint: Your goods vehicle operator's licence, needed for a recovery vehicle over 3.5 tonnes.

documents.label: Photo of your recovery vehicle
documents.hint: Taken from the side, with the registration plate readable.

documents.label: Motorway recovery card (NHSS 17)
documents.hint: Your National Highway Sector Scheme 17 card. Needed before you can take jobs on motorways and high-speed roads.

documents.label: Recovery training certificate
documents.hint: IVR, Level 2 Roadside Vehicle Recovery or similar. Optional, but it helps your application.
